summary: Own the frontend architecture for the core product end to end in React, Next.js and TypeScript — shipping responsive experiences used by 25,000+ people across desktop, tablet and mobile.
highlights: Built a reusable component library (tables, forms, modals, filters, notifications) before duplicate implementations piled up, cutting new-screen build time by 40% across 12+ modules.

Diagnosed slow, unindexed data-table interactions on high-traffic screens and rebuilt them with server-side search, filtering, sorting and pagination; paired with SSR/SSG to lift the Lighthouse/SEO score from 62 to 94.
Replaced spreadsheet-based candidate onboarding — 8 hours a week of operations time — with an internal ATS dashboard, cutting onboarding turnaround by 55%.
Closed a frontend access-control gap with JWT auth and role-based access control against Spring Boot REST APIs backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.
Raised frontend test coverage to 80% with Jest and React Testing Library.
